reviewerRubric.adapter: ContextVault wraps the portable vault and always supplies KithMoot verifyDelegation
reviewerRubric.ownership: verifyDelegation checks the proof agent and then calls verifyAgentOwnership
reviewerRubric.storage: ContextFileStore wraps the portable file store with kithmootContextOptions
reviewerRubric.writes: context_create, context_append, context_import, context_upload, and context_set_grants enter store.run with the write flag
reviewerRubric.caller-boundary: ContextVaultOptions omits verifyDelegation so callers cannot select the room trust policy
